name: Spectral Blade
summary:
Spectral Blade is a turn-based RPG, developed and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 1999.

In combat, the power of your techniques is directly tied to how much energy you unleash. Equip different weapons to unlock unique special skills, and even combine them to unleash devastating special moves. Identify your enemy's weaknesses and unleash powerful techniques to seize victory!
